text: dsh-session-toast 是面向 DSH Windows 环境的会话完成通知插件。它监听会话事件，在一轮结束后调用本地 PowerShell 通知脚本，默认仅在 DSH 不处于前台时提醒。通知可显示会话标题、耗时、轮次或错误摘要，并支持去抖、过滤子代理会话以及 Toast 与气泡通知模式。适合希望切换到其他应用时仍能获知 DSH 任务进度的 Windows 用户。需要 Windows 和 Windows PowerShell 5.1，不需要额外账号或 API 密钥。

dsh-session-toast shows a Windows notification when a DSH turn ends, using a local PowerShell script. It can include the session title, duration, turn number, or error. Notifications are debounced and normally suppressed while DSH is foreground. Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1; no API key is needed.
我切到别的窗口后，怎么知道 DSH 什么时候跑完？
想让 Windows 在一轮会话结束时弹出桌面提醒。
DSH 长任务结束没有提示，有什么办法补上通知？
dsh-session-toast 的功能「会话结束提醒」：在 Windows 上监听 DSH 的会话轮次结束事件，并在短暂去抖后发送系统通知。通知可包含会话标题、运行时长、轮次或错误摘要；若 DSH 正处于前台，默认跳过提醒。

DSH 宿主侧插件：**每当一轮会话回复结束，在 Windows 11 右下角弹出系统通知**，作用类似 Claude Code / Codex 的完成提示。默认只有 DSH 不在前台时才提示，避免盯着屏幕时被打扰。

dsh-session-toast README · 为什么需要它：长任务跑起来以后，人通常会切到别的应用；DSH 这一轮结束、等你下一步输入时，没有任何提示。这个插件把 DSH 的 `turn/end` 事件变成一条 Windows 原生通知，带上会话标题、用时和轮次。

- **零运行时依赖**：没有 npm 依赖、不需要 BurntToast、不写注册表。
- **不打扰**：DSH 在前台时自动跳过。
- **不刷屏**：1.2 秒去抖，下一轮 `turn/start` 会取消上一条待发通知。
- **不炸子代理**：默认忽略 subagent 会话。
- **生命周期干净**：定时器/子进程都由 `ctx.effect` 清理。

dsh-session-toast README · 特性：| 能力 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 完成通知 | 监听 `session/event` → `turn/end`；默认 `completed` 与 `error` |
| 标题 | 取 `session/title`；没有标题时退回工作目录名 |
| 正文 | 会话标题 · 用时 · 第 N 轮；出错时显示错误摘要 |
| 前台策略 | 前台窗口属于 `DeepSeek Harness` 时不弹 |
| 去抖 | 1.2 秒；期间收到 `turn/start` 则取消 |
| 子代理 | 默认不通知；`notifySubagents: true` 打开 |
| 原生 Toast | WinRT `ToastNotificationManager`；不可用时降级 `NotifyIcon` 气泡 |
| 中文安全 | payload 用 base64(UTF-8 JSON)；中文/emoji 不经过代码页 |
| 配置 | 15 个可选键，见[配置](#配置) |

| 其他平台 | 插件自动不激活 |

dsh-session-toast README · 配置：| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；`false` 时插件不注册任何监听 |
| `notifyOn` | `'completed-and-error'` | `'completed'` / `'completed-and-error'` / `'all'`（含 aborted、blocked、max-tokens） |
| `onlyWhenUnfocused` | `true` | DSH 在前台时不弹 |

| `language` | `'zh'` | 内置文案语言：`'zh'` / `'en'` |

| `minTurnDurationMs` | `0` | 短于该时长的轮次不通知 |
| `notifySubagents` | `false` | 是否也通知子代理会话 |
| `dshProcessNames` | `['DeepSeek Harness']` | 判定“DSH 在前台”的进程名（不区分大小写，可写多个） |
| `mode` | `'auto'` | `'auto'` / `'toast'` / `'balloon'` |

dsh-session-toast README · 工作原理：```
DSH session ──turn/start──▶ 记录开始时间，取消待发通知
            ──session/title▶ 缓存会话标题
            ──turn/end────▶ 过滤（子代理 / reason / 最短时长）
                             └─ 1.2s 去抖

- 事件 API：`ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => …)`（与官方 `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 相同的监听方式）。
- 通知投递：`notify.ps1` 由 Windows PowerShell 5.1 执行；payload 用 **base64(UTF-8 JSON)** 通过 argv 传入，中文/emoji 不经过代码页。

text:
dsh-session-toast README · 排查：| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 装好了但完全没通知（先查这条） | 确认插件**真的启用了**：`dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config` 的输出里应有 `# == dsh-session-toast` 这一层；桌面端 Plugins 页应显示 Enabled。只在 `package.json` 依赖里、`dsh.profile.bundles` 里没有这一行时，插件不会被加载，也不会产生任何通知 |
| 完全没通知 | 看 Windows 设置 → 系统 → 通知 是否关闭 / 勿扰；先设 `onlyWhenUnfocused: false`；再设 `logFile` 看 `notify.ps1` 日志 |
| DSH 在前台时不弹 | 这是默认行为；要始终提示就设 `onlyWhenUnfocused: false` |
| 来源标签显示 “Windows PowerShell” | Toast 借用的是系统已注册的 PowerShell AUMID；如需自定义，注册 AppUserModelID 后填 `aumid`（非微软文档保证行为） |
| 子代理任务不弹 | 默认 `notifySubagents: false`；需要时打开（可能一次任务弹多条） |
| 通知太多 | 调大 `minTurnDurationMs` / `debounceMs`，或 `notifyOn: 'completed'` |
| 想看插件是否加载 | 启动日志出现 `[dsh-session-toast] loaded (…)` |

dsh-session-toast README · 排查：调试时设置环境变量 `DSH_SESSION_TOAST_DEBUG=1`（0.1.x 的 `DSH_SESSION_NOTIFIER_DEBUG=1` 仍兼容）：DSH 控制台会打印每条 `turn/end` 的去向（入队，或被哪条规则跳过）、实际 payload、PowerShell PID，并把 `notify.ps1` 的 `DELIVERED` / `SKIPPED reason=…` 透传出来 —— 这是判断“到底是没加载、被过滤、还是被前台策略跳过”的最快方式。

dsh-session-toast README · 已知限制：- 仅 Windows（`process.platform === 'win32'`），其他平台插件自动不激活。
- 通知依赖 Windows PowerShell 5.1（Win11 自带）；无 `pwsh`、无 BurntToast 也能用。
- 勿扰 / 通知总开关关闭时，Toast 可能被系统静默丢弃，脚本无法检测；可用 `mode: 'balloon'` 换通道。
- Toast 约 5 秒后自动消失；不实现点击跳转/聚焦 DSH。
- 通知正文包含会话标题（本地显示，不联网）。
- 子代理默认不通知；多会话并行时按会话分别通知。
- 使用 `session/title` 作为标题；若会话从未生成标题，则退回目录名。
- **goal / 自动续跑**：去抖只覆盖 1.2 秒内立刻开始的下一轮；goal 续跑如果先 `await session/flush` 或等待子代理超过该窗口，会先提示“完成”再继续跑。DSH 目前没有公开的 “session idle” 事件（最接近的是 `agent/status === 'idle'`），本插件未用 `agent/status` 做门控；如需更严格可调大 `debounceMs` 或暂时关闭 goal。

dsh-session-toast README · 安全：- 插件只读取 `session/title`、`session/header.cwd`、`turn/end`、`session/disposed` 事件。
- 只启动本地 `powershell.exe`（`-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden`），不联网、不读取凭据、不做 shell 字符串拼接（参数走数组传递）。
- 运行时不需要 GitHub token 或任何账号数据；可选的 `logFile` 只包含通知文案。
- 漏洞报告见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

A DeepSeek Harness host plugin that shows a **Windows 11 toast notification when a session turn finishes** — similar to Claude Code / Codex completion notifications. By default it only notifies when DSH is not in the foreground, so you are not interrupted while watching a response.

dsh-session-toast README · Why：Long agent runs are common. You switch to another app, the turn finishes, and nothing tells you. This plugin turns DSH's `turn/end` event into a native Windows notification with the session title, duration and turn number.

dsh-session-toast README · Why：- **Zero runtime dependencies** — no npm packages, no BurntToast, no registry writes.
- **Focus-aware** — checks whether `DeepSeek Harness` owns the foreground window before showing anything.
- **Coalesced** — a 1.2 s debounce cancels a pending toast when the next turn starts (goal / inbox continuation).
- **Subagent-safe** — subagent sessions are ignored by default to avoid toast storms.
- **Clean lifecycle** — every timer and child process is registered through `ctx.effect`.

dsh-session-toast README · Features：| Feature | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Turn completion | Listens to `session/event` → `turn/end`; notifies on `completed` and `error` by default |
| Title | Uses `session/title`; falls back to the working-directory name |
| Body | Session title · duration · turn number; error message on failures |
| Focus policy | Suppresses the toast while `DeepSeek Harness` is foreground |
| Debounce | 1.2 s; a following `turn/start` cancels the pending toast |
| Subagents | Off by default; enable with `notifySubagents: true` |
| Native toast | WinRT `ToastNotificationManager`; falls back to `NotifyIcon` balloon |
| Unicode-safe | Payload is base64(UTF-8 JSON); Chinese and emoji survive PowerShell 5.1 |
| Config | 15 optional keys (see [Configuration](#configuration)) |

dsh-session-toast README · Requirements：- Windows 11 (Windows PowerShell 5.1 is present on every install).
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` (tested; declared in `dsh.compatibility`).
- Node.js 20+ (provided by DSH).

The plugin is inactive on non-Windows platforms.
dsh-session-toast README · Install：> ⚠️ Install under the name **`dsh-session-toast`** only. The npm package `dsh-session-notifier` belongs to a different author and is unrelated to this project.

```

dsh-session-toast README · Configuration：All keys are optional. Overrides are **whole-row replacements** — repeat every key you need.

dsh-session-toast README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` registers nothing |
| `notifyOn` | `'completed-and-error'` | `'completed'`, `'completed-and-error'`, or `'all'` (also aborted / blocked / max-tokens) |
| `onlyWhenUnfocused` | `true` | Skip while DSH owns the foreground window |
| `sound` | `true` | Play the system notification sound |
| `language` | `'zh'` | Built-in strings: `'zh'` or `'en'` |
| `debounceMs` | `1200` | Coalescing window; a following `turn/start` cancels |
| `minTurnDurationMs` | `0` | Skip turns shorter than this |
| `notifySubagents` | `false` | Also notify subagent sessions |
| `dshProcessNames` | `['DeepSeek Harness']` | Process names considered "DSH is focused" (case-insensitive) |
| `mode` | `'auto'` | `'auto'`, `'toast'`, or `'balloon'` |
| `aumid` | `''` | Optional registered AppUserModelID; defaults to the PowerShell AUMID |
| `logFile` | `''` | UTF-8 diagnostic log written by `notify.ps1` |
| `timeoutMs` | `20000` | Kill a hung notifier process after this |
| `dryRun` | `false` | Log the payload instead of showing a toast (tests) |
| `appName` | `'DeepSeek Harness'` |

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-toast

  config:
    enabled: true

> Do not hand-edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` or its `cordis.patch.yml`; the Desktop profile is managed by the plugin manager. Use `--patch <overlay.yml>` for temporary development overlays.

dsh-session-toast README · How it works：```
DSH session ──turn/start──▶ remember start time, cancel pending toast
            ──session/title▶ cache title
            ──turn/end────▶ filter (subagent / reason / min duration)
                             └─ 1.2 s debounce

dsh-session-toast README · How it works：- Event API: `ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => …)`, the same pattern used by the official `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` package.

- The plugin imports **no `@deepseek-ai/*` packages**; only Node built-ins. A local `link:` install therefore does not depend on module resolution inside the DSH installation directory.

dsh-session-toast README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| No notification | Check Windows Settings → System → Notifications / Focus Assist; set `onlyWhenUnfocused: false`; set `logFile` and inspect the notifier log |
| Installed but nothing ever fires (check this first) | Confirm the plugin is actually **enabled**: `dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config` must contain a `# == dsh-session-toast` layer, and the desktop Plugins page must show Enabled. A package that is only a dependency in `package.json` while missing from `dsh.profile.bundles` is never loaded, so it can never notify |
| Nothing while DSH is focused | Intended default; use `onlyWhenUnfocused: false` |
| Source label says "Windows PowerShell" | The toast borrows the registered PowerShell AUMID; register a custom AUMID and set `aumid` if you need a different label |
| Subagent turns do not notify | `notifySubagents` defaults to `false` |
| Too many notifications | Increase `minTurnDurationMs` / `debounceMs`, or use `notifyOn: 'completed'` |
| Plugin did not load | Startup log should contain `[dsh-session-toast] loaded (…)` |

dsh-session-toast README · Troubleshooting：Set `DSH_SESSION_TOAST_DEBUG=1` (`DSH_SESSION_NOTIFIER_DEBUG=1` from 0.1.x still works) to make DSH's console print where each `turn/end` went — queued, or skipped by which rule — plus the exact payload, the PowerShell PID and `notify.ps1`'s own `DELIVERED` / `SKIPPED reason=…` lines. That is the quickest way to tell "not loaded" from "filtered" from "suppressed by the focus policy".

dsh-session-toast README · Known limitations：- Windows only; the plugin is inactive elsewhere.
- Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1 (present on Windows 11); no `pwsh`/BurntToast needed.
- Focus Assist or a disabled notification toggle can drop the toast silently. `mode: 'balloon'` is an alternative channel.
- Toast disappears after ~5 seconds; there is no click-to-focus action.
- Notification text includes the session title and is rendered locally only.
- Goal continuations that start more than the debounce window after `turn/end` may produce a "completed" toast before the goal really finishes. DSH exposes no public session-idle event; tune `debounceMs` if needed.

dsh-session-toast README · Security：- The plugin reads only `session/title`, `session/header.cwd`, `turn/end` and `session/disposed` events.
- It spawns a local PowerShell process with `-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden`; no network, no credential access, no shell interpolation (arguments are passed as an array).
- No GitHub token or account data is used at runtime. The optional `logFile` contains notification text only.
- See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for reporting.

dsh-session-toast README · Uninstall：Desktop: **Plugins → dsh-session-toast → Remove**.

Other profiles:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-session-toast
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | Select-String "dsh-session-toast"
```
